settings.restrictionsDesc: Headscale supports restricting OIDC authentication to only allow certain email domains, groups, or users to authenticate. This can be used to limit access to your Tailnet to only certain users or groups and Headplane will also respect these settings when authenticating.

restrictions.title: Authentication Restrictions
restrictions.description: Headscale supports restricting OIDC authentication to only allow certain email domains, groups, or users to authenticate. This can be used to limit access to your Tailnet to only certain users or groups and Headplane will also respect these settings when authenticating.
restrictions.permissionsRestrictedDesc: You do not have the necessary permissions to edit the Authentication Restrictions settings. Please contact your administrator to request access or to make changes to these settings.

restrictions.invalidDomain: This is not a valid domain.
restrictions.domainEnter: Enter a domain to match users with their email addresses.
restrictions.addUserDesc: Add this user to a list of allowed users that can authenticate with Headscale via OIDC.
restrictions.userDesc: The user to allow for OIDC authentication.
restrictions.userExists: This user already exists in the list.

users.title: Users
users.description: Manage the users in your network and their permissions.

users.allUsersLinked: All Headscale users are already linked to other accounts.

users.ownerCannotChange: The Tailnet owner cannot be reassigned.

roles.networkAdminDesc: Can view the admin console and manage ACLs and network settings. Cannot manage devices or users.

roles.viewerDesc: Can view devices and users, and generate their own auth keys.

acls.policyUnavailableAction1: Create the ACL policy file at the specified path in your Headscale configuration.
acls.policyUnavailableAction2: Alternatively, you can switch Headscale to use database mode for ACLs by updating your Headscale configuration. This will allow Headplane to manage the ACL policy directly through the web interface.
